recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-angle close-up portrait of a man with long dark hair, featuring a warm, slightly desaturated color palette and a soft-focus analog quality. The composition is anchored by bold, psychedelic-influenced display lettering at the top center, layered over a secondary sans-serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against a muted teal-blue background
Heavy, dark hair framing a downward-looking face
Vibrant purple and yellow display type contrasting with white secondary text
Soft, diffused lighting creating gentle shadows on the facial features
coreInvariants: High-angle perspective looking down at the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's head occupies approximately 80% of the frame, positioned centrally but looking downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top-center display lettering serves as the primary focal point for branding.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vibrant top text, moves down the dark hair to the subject's downward-gaze, following the line of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper corners with a muted teal sky-like background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the hair providing structural weight.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted teal-blue background providing a cool counterpoint to warm skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow and deep purple in the primary logo lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation overall with high value contrast between the white shirt and dark hair.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and muted 70s pastels

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower-case style 'L' with exaggerated top loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between organic, heavy display type and rigid, light geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow as a secondary color block

preserve: The heavy bottom-weight of the display font
The wide tracking of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the soft-edged, heavy 70s display feel
Matches the clean, utilitarian feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus 1970s film photograph of a man with long, dark, feathered hair looking down. Warm lighting on the face, wearing a white collared shirt. Background is a muted teal-blue sky. High-angle shot.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, heavy psychedelic display title in yellow with a thick purple drop shadow at the top center. Below it, add a subtitle in all-caps white sans-serif with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the display font heavy and rounded?
Is the grain texture visible and analog-style?
Is the subject looking down at a high angle?
Is the color palette warm and muted?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the corners
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple shadow is thick and offset
Check that the white shirt collar is prominent
Verify the high-angle perspective is maintained
Confirm the grain doesn't look like digital noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-angle soft-focus portrait with a dual-layered typographic stack consisting of a heavy psychedelic display font and a wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle.
